note: Each case is an assessment composed from datasets/questions_v1.json (with the annotator's type/difficulty/Bloom labels supplied as faculty metadata). expected_flags is the reviewer's manual judgement per quality dimension (OK = acceptable, FLAG = the reviewer would raise this dimension). expected_problem_categories lists the recommendation categories the reviewer expects FacultyLens to raise; rating_band is the acceptable overall rating set. Labels were written from the question list before any engine output was inspected.
